tested.environment: local dev server (pnpm dev), seeded test account with 3 notes, desktop 1280x800, light and dark

flow.given: a note titled "Trip plan" with a heading, a checklist and a link
flow.when: I choose Download as Markdown from the note's menu
flow.then: trip-plan-n42.md downloads, its first line is "# Trip plan", and the checklist and link read the same as in the app

flow.given: an account with three notes, two of them titled "Ideas"
flow.when: I click Export all notes in Settings
flow.then: jotter-notes-2026-10-14.zip downloads with three .md files whose names are all different
continues: the Settings page still saves the theme choice

flow.when: I download it as Markdown, and again inside Export all notes
flow.then: the file is named q3-q4-plans-draft-n57.md in both cases and the zip has no folders

flow.expect: 0 failures, including the serializer and file-name cases

jank.item: Menu item and button show a pressed state and do not double-download on a double click
Export all notes shows "Preparing…" while the zip builds and re-enables after
No console errors or failed requests during any download

fix_log.finding: J-3: the zip held a folder "q3" with "q4-plans-draft-n57.md" inside it
fix_log.cause: The zip writer received the raw title; only the single-note path used the safe file-name function

assumed: Downloads behave the same in other desktop browsers; QA drove one browser only
The journeys were not re-driven after the review fix in e21f8b6; it only changed a response header, which S-1 now tests
surprises: Checklist items are stored with a "done" flag, not as text, so the serializer had to write "- [x]" itself (build-P-1)
Two code paths built file names; the zip path skipped the safe-name function until QA round 1 caught it
